The London South Bank University's highly creative degree program, accredited by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) and Architects Registration Board (ARB), offers students a wide foundation of architectural knowledge. Students will learn to draw, model, write, and, above all, define and solve problems that have genuine social purpose. They will study the exploration of design; review the histories and theories of architecture; and investigate structures, construction, and design for sustainability.

Studying with the University will help graduates determine their own interests and find their individual voice. The University will also introduce them to the necessary skills for professional practice. When students successfully graduate, they will have completed the first step towards becoming a qualified architect.

The Bachelor of Arts in Business Management has been designed with the students' future in mind and developed with input from businesses so they gain the expertise they need to succeed in the modern world. By studying with London South Bank University, they will develop knowledge and skills across key business disciplines, focusing on the study of organizations, management, and the changing environment in which they operate.

On their journey with London South Bank University, graduates will interact with a strong network of professional bodies, industry specialists and alumni; and they will have the opportunity for fully supported entrepreneurial activity. London South Bank University offers an innovative blended learning approach to support they needs and develop their key digital, analytical and coaching skills along the way.

Students also have the opportunity to undertake a work placement within an established workplace or with an enterprise start-up.

The Master of Architecture in Architecture at the London South Bank University promotes a studio-based culture which encourages debate and enquiry about contemporary societies, the postmodern city, and relationships between urban and landscape conditions. Students will consider these through a range of innovative and personal responses to architectural design projects; environmental and constructional technologies; critical research expressed in extended, structured writing, and the skills needed to operate as a progressive professional practitioner.

This course will see students build on analytical design skills and professional competences established at undergraduate level, with a focus on innovation in design, construction, and resource efficient technology. Working in vertical design studios, they will develop an understanding of, and methods relevant to contemporary professional practice, together with an ability to produce complex and diverse design proposals.

Students who are passionate about current and emerging challenges facing towns, cities and rural areas, want to help shape people's future built and natural environments and want to study planning at the heart of one of the world’s most exciting cities then the Master of Arts in Town and Country Planning provide the answer. The courses focus on interactions between people and place and how to facilitate high quality developments in the right location.

This course is fully accredited by the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI). With two years relevant work experience, students can apply to take the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) Assessment of Professional Competence exam.

The academic staff have expertise in a range of planning related fields and are all research active with a strong track record in national and international research networks, projects and publications.
6nki:
The Master of Arts in Urban Design and Planning focuses on urban design as part of town planning, giving students the opportunity to develop their understanding of urban design and development issues through working at different scales of the city and engaging with theoretical debates.

‘Planning’ is both a design and public policy profession. It deals with design as a professional and a democratic practice, showing how professional knowledge and deep engagement with communities are both essential if places are to achieve lasting functionality and liveability.
74yk:
The Master of Science in Accounting and Finance has been designed to provide an academic route to students' continuing professional development and enhance their career opportunities or be a stepping stone to further research.

This course explores contemporary and specialized approaches in accounting and finance. The ever-changing legal framework in which the financial sector operates, combined with the latest developments in accounting and reporting, call for key practical, theoretical, and empirical issues to be further analyzed through further academic research.

Graduates will have access to prestigious resources, such as the Bloomberg computer suite, to analyze company and industry data from companies and organizations across the world.

This qualification is designed for learners who wish to pursue a career in the financial services industry, professional accountancy, banking, and finance or management. Learners will be equipped with the essential skills and knowledge needed to pursue high-level careers in all types of organizations in the public and private sector and within industry and commerce.
